Name: Intensity
Description: Controls the strength of the slope blur effect. Higher values result in more pronounced blurring along the slope direction.

Name: Iterations
Description: Specifies how many times the slope blur operation is applied. More iterations increase the smoothness and diffusion of the blur.

Name: Direction
Description: Sets the primary direction in which the blur is applied. Adjusting this value changes the orientation of the blur effect across the terrain.

Name: Asymmetry
Description: Controls the asymmetry of the blur, allowing the effect to be stronger in one direction than the other for more natural or stylized results.

Flubs.Name: Box
Flubs.Description: Uses a box-shaped window for uniform blurring, resulting in sharper transitions at the edges.

Name: Quality
Description: Settings related to the quality and precision of the slope blur operation. Higher quality may increase processing time but results in smoother, more accurate blurring.

Name: Quality
Description: Selects the quality level for the slope blur effect, balancing performance and visual fidelity.

Flubs.Name: Low
Flubs.Description: Fastest processing with minimal detail. Suitable for previews or low-quality outputs.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced quality and performance. Provides moderate detail suitable for most workflows.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: Higher detail and smoother results, with increased processing time.

Flubs.Name: Ultra
Flubs.Description: Maximum detail and smoothness. Best for final outputs, but may be slower to process.

Name: Antialiasing
Description: Applies antialiasing to the slope blur effect, reducing jagged edges and improving visual smoothness.

Flubs.Name: Off
Flubs.Description: No antialiasing is applied. May result in sharper but potentially jagged edges.

Flubs.Name: x4
Flubs.Description: Applies 4x antialiasing for moderate smoothing of edges.

Flubs.Name: x16
Flubs.Description: Applies 16x antialiasing for maximum edge smoothing and highest visual quality.
